concerns.text: Path conflict makes tasks unexecutable as written: plan.md places code at `src/pipeline/` and tests at `tests/`, while every task writes to `code/pipeline/` and `code/tests/`; plan Phase 5 also writes figures to `outputs/figures/` while T007/T010 write to `figures/`. An implementer cannot satisfy both layouts; pick one and reconcile.

Constitution mandates a strict group-aware 80% train / 20% held-out test split with no batch leakage, but no task creates or evaluates on a held-out 20% set — T004–T006 implement only 5-fold GroupKFold CV. The constitution's requirement is unreachable under the current task set; add a task for the 80/20 split and final held-out evaluation or reconcile the constitution.

Constitution requires a pinned `requirements.txt`/`pyproject.toml` at `code/` and states the Code-Execution Agent builds an isolated venv from it, but no task creates or verifies this file. Without it, T012's 're-run the full documented workflow' verification cannot execute in the mandated environment.

T004's verification ('the documented command in the feature's `quickstart.md` runs end-to-end') and T012's ('single command documented in the feature's `quickstart.md`') depend on a quickstart.md that no task creates or updates. Add authoring/updating quickstart.md with the exact command to a task, or inline the command in the task.
T006 uses ΔR² as the permutation statistic, but FR-002 specifies 'RMSE change as statistic'. The implementer cannot deterministically choose; align spec and task on one statistic.

T001 leaves the dataset recipe open-ended ('e.g. `datasets.load_dataset(...)` or a pinned Zenodo/figshare URL; if no single dataset contains all required columns, task a documented multi-source merge'). No concrete dataset, URL, or column mapping is named, so two implementers would fetch different data and the SHA-256 verification is not reproducible. Name the concrete source(s) (or make selecting-and-recording it an explicit first deliverable with its own verification).

T003 computes and reports VIF for interaction columns, but FR-006 explicitly excludes interaction terms from the VIF check. The task is executable but contradicts its cited requirement; either narrow the task to base predictors or amend FR-006.
T007 tags SC-005 for the SHAP driver ranking, but SC-005 is the Jaccard-stability criterion delivered by T008; correct the traceability tag.
